- Stakeholders we discussed: engineering/ML owner, procurement, legal. Please confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact so we can route contract/PO items correctly.

2) What is your procurement timeline for issuing a PO once SOW & pricing are agreed?
3) Any vendor onboarding docs we should fill out now (tax forms, W9-equivalent, security checklist)?

I'm attaching a draft SOW and our vendor onboarding form to accelerate the procurement path. If you like, we can set a 30-minute procurement + legal sync next week to walk through the checklist and PO process.
